scientific_integrity: Proof classifies cyclic run signatures in all composition cases; independently implemented canonical-string and cyclic-run algorithms exhaustively test 120 parameter pairs but finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.

title: Exact two-deletion circular traces for a single elongated run
